patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a dark overlay for text contrast, transitioning to a clean white background for subsequent content sections.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are paired with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels to introduce sections or features.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and crisp white is punctuated by a vibrant, electric cyan accent color for calls to action and graphic elements.
The transparent header transforms into a solid, slightly smaller sticky header with a background and subtle shadow upon scrolling past the hero section.
The hero background image employs a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content as the user scrolls down.
Feature sections are presented as dark, full-width cards with white text, creating a strong visual break from the lighter background sections.

technique_notes: A sticky header dynamically changes its appearance, including background, size, and shadow, after a specific scroll threshold is met.
The hero background image utilizes a subtle parallax effect, where it scrolls at a different speed than the foreground content to create a sense of depth.
Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated using GSAP ScrollTrigger to enhance engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for impact, complemented by smaller uppercase sans-serif labels and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on buttons and image cards) provide a soft, modern feel without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content blocks for readability.

standout: The bold, graphic use of the vibrant cyan accent, particularly the striking line through the hero text and the full-bleed call-to-action section, combined with sophisticated photography, creates a distinctive modern and trustworthy aesthetic.
